# FacTech

> FacTech is a software company based in Bursa, Turkey, founded in 2026 by software engineers. It builds web applications, iOS and Android mobile apps, UI/UX designs and cloud systems, and provides cyber security and data analytics services. FacTech works in Turkish and English.

## Company facts

- Name: FacTech
- Website: https://factech.app/
- Location: Bursa, Turkey
- Founded: 2026
- Languages: Turkish, English
- Email: info@factech.app
- Phone: +90 535 702 79 18

## Services

- Web Development: responsive, fast, SEO-optimized and secure websites built with modern technologies.
- Mobile App Development: native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.
- UI/UX Design: user-centered, functional interface design.
- Cloud Solutions: scalable, secure systems on AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.
- Cyber Security: security solutions including penetration testing and security audits.
- Data Analytics: AI and machine-learning powered analytics.
